Game Overview

Parcel Delivery is a adventure title where venture into an eerie apartment building as a parcel delivery person, uncovering unsettling mysteries hidden within a seemingly normal day. In this 2D pixel side-scroller, your choices lead to different endings, testing your nerves and curiosity. Will you simply observe, or uncover the truth?
